Seems that the problem we took a look at last week was opened by Matthias Medwenitsch.

additional_info.subject: 0401986 - ID0401986-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S5 170003620] errors occur when charging an eActros & & Mercedes EQE CRM:02023000447
additional_info.body:
Hi colleagues, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I checked this ticket and it seems that the FC16 tripped during charging while in v4.0.11, there was indeed a bug declared by R&D that had this surge result in failure. In v6.0.3 there is a new timeout so that this surge doesn't cause the charger to stop.
Since both chargers are now in v6.0.3 let me know if you faced this issue since 23rd Jan for pHAdNC and 24th for ASl07a. If there is no issue during charging then I will close this ticket.
The problem with the mainbreaker is still being handled in ticket 0401569 which is different.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
